none: migration `036` restricts `complete_task` to `status IN ('claimed','running')`, returns distinct `task_not_active` with current status, and `WorkQueueService.complete()` warns on that refusal; live tests cover late complete-after-reconcile-cancel refusal and ordinary claimed completion success.

none: reused ZAP evidence remains valid for the final product tree — SHA-256 of `zap.stdout.log` / `zap-report.json` match `execution.json`, `gate.json` is PASS with `triggered_count=0`, no dependency manifests changed since the retained scan base, product tree at `377b9deb` is `d403701f…`, and post-product commits only add evidence/orchestration; PR #457 checks at that exact SHA are all substantive pass with `test-integration` green.

none: Validation 7's Package Evidence warning (residual advisory to restore per-package work-result persistence) and Architecture DEGRADED (advisory source-root refresh defect) remain honestly scoped and non-blocking; `architecture-impact.md`'s Canonical Validation 7 Audit cites the correct product commit/tree and does not treat either as a merge blocker.

Nit: Canonical Validation 7 Residual Advisories duplicates item `3` (architecture-impact header drift appears twice, with items numbered 1–4 then another `3`), a report-editing slip that does not change the PASS decision or the advisory non-blocking scope.
findings.resolution: Renumber residual advisories to a unique 1–4 list when next editing the validation report.

findings.description: FYI: `reconcile_projection()` scans caller `input_data` before merging `projection_key` into the RPC payload, whereas `submit()` merges the projection key into `input_data` before the guardrail scan — so the texts are not byte-identical on keyed calls. Projection-key fields are tightly validated (change_id/phase/sequence), so this is not a practical bypass of the new reconcile screen.
findings.resolution: Optionally merge `key.as_input_data()` into the scanned payload first if strict scan-text identity with `submit()` is desired.
